checkpoints.description: [1/2] Skip GGUF magic re-read for cached files on forced rescans: 59.3ms -> 12.5ms, controlled A/B 2.43x

impact_assessment.benefits: Import/delete rescans on large libraries avoid one file open+read per unchanged model
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first header-read counter test plus non-GGUF rejection check, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression
impact_assessment.risks: contract: same models listed; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: cache key already trusts size+mtime so a cached file is known valid; non-GGUF files still checked every time
impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; a 200-model forced rescan reopened every file for four-byte header validation even when metadata was cached

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Parallelize independent stat calls in the registry scan: 63.4ms -> 5.9ms, controlled A/B 3.28x

impact_assessment.benefits: Full scans of large libraries gather file stats concurrently while preserving per-file error handling
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first mode seam plus behavioral equivalence over valid/missing/non-GGUF files, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression
